BanAllComment.description_en: Mutes all users in a room by calling the BanAllComment operation
BanAllComment.description_zh: 调用BanAllComment接口，禁言房间内所有用户

BanComment.description_en: Mutes a specific user in a room
BanComment.description_zh: 调用BanComment接口，实现对房间内某特定用户实施禁言操作

CancelBanAllComment.description_en: Cancels the mute-all restriction in a room
CancelBanAllComment.description_zh: 调用CancelBanAllComment接口，取消房间内全员禁言的限制

CancelBanComment.description_en: Cancels the comment ban on a specific user in a room
CancelBanComment.description_zh: 调用CancelBanComment接口，取消对房间内某特定用户的禁言

CancelUserAdmin.description_en: Cancels the administrator role of a specific user in a room, changing the user to a regular viewer
CancelUserAdmin.description_zh: 调用CancelUserAdmin接口，取消房间内某特定用户管理员身份，变成普通观众

CreateClass.description_en: Creates a class by calling CreateClass. The class can be used for scenarios such as student learning and workplace training, and provides features such as co-streaming, live streaming, whiteboard, and chat
CreateClass.description_zh: 调用CreateClass创建课程。可用于学生上课，职场培训等场景，包含连麦、直播、白板、聊天等功能

CreateLive.description_en: Creates a live stream with a creation status of not yet started
CreateLive.description_zh: 创建状态为未开播的新直播

CreateLiveRecordSliceFile.description_en: Creates a live recording slice file by calling CreateLiveRecordSliceFile
CreateLiveRecordSliceFile.description_zh: 调用CreateLiveRecordSliceFile创建直播录制片段文件

CreateLiveRoom.description_en: Invokes CreateLiveRoom to create a live room in the creation status
CreateLiveRoom.description_zh: 调用CreateLiveRoom创建状态为未开播的新直播

CreateRoom.description_en: Creates a room. Users can use features such as live streaming, whiteboard, and audio and video communication in the room
CreateRoom.description_zh: 调用CreateRoom创建一个房间，用户可以在房间内使用直播、白板、音视频通信等功能

DeleteClass.description_en: Deletes a class by calling DeleteClass

DeleteComment.description_en: Calls DeleteComment to delete a comment message

DeleteConference.description_en: Ends a co-streaming session by calling DeleteConference. This operation is typically used to end a session from the management console or to forcibly end a session that has not been exited for an extended period of time
DeleteConference.description_zh: 调用DeleteConference结束连麦。一般用于管理后台结束，或长时间未退出时的强制结束

DeleteLiveFilesById.description_en: Calls the DeleteLiveFilesById operation to delete the recording files of a live stream
DeleteLiveFilesById.description_zh: 调用DeleteLiveFilesById接口删除该直播的录制文件

DeleteLiveRoom.description_en: Deletes a live streaming record by calling DeleteLiveRoom

DeleteRoom.description_en: Deletes a specified room. After the room is deleted, it can no longer be used
DeleteRoom.description_zh: 调用DeleteRoom删除指定房间，删除后房间无法继续使用

DeleteSensitiveWord.description_en: Deletes sensitive words by calling DeleteSensitiveWord

DescribeMeterImpPlayBackTimeByLiveId.description_en: Queries the playback duration of a specified live streaming resource by calling DescribeMeterImpPlayBackTimeByLiveId
DescribeMeterImpPlayBackTimeByLiveId.description_zh: 调用DescribeMeterImpPlayBackTimeByLiveId查询指定直播资源的回看时长

DescribeMeterImpWatchLiveTimeByLiveId.description_en: Queries watch duration data by live stream ID, including standard-latency watch duration and low-latency watch duration
DescribeMeterImpWatchLiveTimeByLiveId.description_zh: 调用DescribeMeterImpWatchLiveTimeByLiveId查看观看时长相关数据，包含普通延迟观看时长，低延迟观看时长

GetAuthToken.description_en: Retrieves a persistent connection token. The client can use this token to communicate with various atomic capabilities through the LWP protocol over persistent connections
GetAuthToken.description_zh: 调用GetAuthToken获取长连接建连Token，客户端可以用此Token通过LWP协议和各个原子能力进行长连接通信

GetClassDetail.description_en: Queries the details of a class by calling GetClassDetail. You can use this operation to query the class status and the IDs of associated resources such as live streaming, co-streaming, and whiteboard. You can use these IDs to further query the details of the corresponding live streaming, co-streaming, and whiteboard resources
GetClassDetail.description_zh: 调用GetClassDetail获取课程详情。可用于查询课程状态，以及相关联的直播，连麦，白板等ID信息。通过这些ID，可进一步查询对应的直播，连麦，白板的详情

GetClassRecord.description_en: Calls GetClassRecord to retrieve class recording information. You can use this operation to obtain the playback URL after a class ends. If the class has not ended, the result is empty
GetClassRecord.description_zh: 调用GetClassRecord获取课程录制信息。可用于课程结束后获取回放地址，如果课程未结束，结果为空

GetConference.description_en: Queries the information about a specified co-streaming session by calling GetConference, including the co-streaming title and status. You can also query the recording URL after the co-streaming session ends
GetConference.description_zh: 调用GetConference查询指定连麦信息，包含连麦标题和连麦状态。也可查询连麦结束后的录制地址

GetLive.description_en: Queries information associated with a specified live stream
GetLive.description_zh: 查询与指定直播相关联的信息

GetLiveRecord.description_en: Retrieves live recording information. You can call this operation to obtain the playback URL after a live stream ends. If the live stream has not ended, the result is empty
GetLiveRecord.description_zh: 调用GetLiveRecord获取直播录制信息。可用于直播结束后获取回放地址，如果直播未结束，结果为空

GetLiveRoom.description_en: Queries the information about a specified live room by calling GetLiveRoom
GetLiveRoom.description_zh: 调用GetLiveRoom查询指定直播相关信息

GetLiveRoomStatistics.description_en: Invokes GetLiveRoomStatistics to query the statistics information of a specified live room. This operation is planned to be replaced by a new solution and is not recommended
GetLiveRoomStatistics.description_zh: 调用GetLiveRoomStatistics查询与指定直播相关的数据统计信息。后续计划迁入新方案，不推荐使用

GetLiveRoomUserStatistics.description_en: Invokes GetLiveRoomUserStatistics to query user viewing statistics for a specified live room by paging. This operation is planned to be migrated to a new solution and is not recommended
GetLiveRoomUserStatistics.description_zh: 调用GetLiveRoomUserStatistics分页查询与指定直播相关的用户观看数据。后续计划迁入新方案，不推荐使用

GetRoom.description_en: Queries the information about a specified room, including room details and active atomic capability information
GetRoom.description_zh: 调用GetRoom查询指定房间信息，包含房间信息和使用中的原子能力信息

GetStandardRoomJumpUrl.description_en: Retrieves a redirect URL for the low-code service by calling GetStandardRoomJumpUrl
GetStandardRoomJumpUrl.description_zh: 调用GetStandardRoomJumpUrl获取低代码服务跳转链接

KickRoomUser.description_en: Kicks a specific user out of a room by calling the KickRoomUser operation
KickRoomUser.description_zh: 调用KickRoomUser接口，实现对房间内某特定用户实施踢出房间操作

ListClasses.description_en: Invokes ListClasses to retrieve a list of classes. You can perform a paged query of all classes for an application by application ID and class status
ListClasses.description_zh: 调用ListClasses获取课程列表。可基于应用ID和课程状态，分页查询应用对应的所有课程列表

ListComments.description_en: Queries comment messages in batches by calling ListComments
ListComments.description_zh: 调用ListComments批量查询弹幕消息

ListConferenceUsers.description_en: Calls ListConferenceUsers to query co-streaming user information by paging
ListConferenceUsers.description_zh: 调用ListConferenceUsers分页查询连麦用户信息

ListLiveFiles.description_en: Queries the list of live stream recording files by calling ListLiveFiles
ListLiveFiles.description_zh: 调用ListLiveFiles获取直播录制文件列表信息

ListLiveRooms.description_en: Invokes ListLiveRooms to query live room information by using paging
ListLiveRooms.description_zh: 调用ListLiveRooms分页查询直播信息

ListLiveRoomsById.description_en: Queries the information about specified live rooms in batch by live room ID by calling ListLiveRoomsById
ListLiveRoomsById.description_zh: 调用ListLiveRoomsById根据传入的直播ID批量查询指定的直播信息

ListRoomUsers.description_en: Invokes ListRoomUsers to query the real-time user list in a room by paging
ListRoomUsers.description_zh: 调用ListRoomUsers分页查询房间内的实时用户列表

ListRooms.description_en: Queries the list of rooms under an application, including the information about each room and the atomic capabilities in use
ListRooms.description_zh: 调用ListRooms查询应用下的房间列表，包含每个房间的信息和正在使用的原子能力信息

ListSensitiveWord.description_en: Queries sensitive words by calling ListSensitiveWord

PublishLive.description_en: Publishes a live stream, changes the live stream status to streaming, and retrieves the push and pull stream URLs
PublishLive.description_zh: 发布直播，将直播状态转变为直播中，并获取推拉流地址

PublishLiveRoom.description_en: Calls the PublishLiveRoom operation to publish a live room, change the live room status to streaming, and obtain the push and pull stream URLs
PublishLiveRoom.description_zh: 调用PublishLiveRoom发布直播，将直播状态转变为直播中，并获取推拉流地址

RemoveMember.description_en: Removes a specified user from a conference call by calling RemoveMember
RemoveMember.description_zh: 调用RemoveMember将指定用户从连麦中踢出

SendComment.description_en: Sends a comment message by calling SendComment. The comment message is pushed to all online users in the room
SendComment.description_zh: 调用SendComment发送弹幕消息，该弹幕消息会推送给房间内所有在线人员

SendCustomMessageToAll.description_en: Calls SendCustomMessageToAll to send a custom message to all online members in a room
SendCustomMessageToAll.description_zh: 调用SendCustomMessageToAll向房间中全部在线成员发送自定义消息

SendCustomMessageToUsers.description_en: Sends a custom message to specified members in a room by calling SendCustomMessageToUsers
SendCustomMessageToUsers.description_zh: 调用SendCustomMessageToUsers向房间中的指定成员发送自定义消息

SetUserAdmin.description_en: Sets a specific user as an administrator in a room by calling the SetUserAdmin operation
SetUserAdmin.description_zh: 调用SetUserAdmin接口，设置房间内某特定用户为管理员

StopClass.description_en: Stops a class by calling StopClass, which changes the class status to ended
StopClass.description_zh: 调用StopClass执行结束课程动作，会修改课程状态为已下课

StopLive.description_en: Stops a specified live stream and changes the live stream status to ended
StopLive.description_zh: 停止指定直播，直播状态改变为直播结束

StopLiveRoom.description_en: Stops a specified live room by calling StopLiveRoom. The live room status changes to ended
StopLiveRoom.description_zh: 调用StopLiveRoom停止指定直播，直播状态改变为直播结束

UpdateClass.description_en: Updates a class by calling UpdateClass

UpdateLive.description_en: Updates the information of a specified live broadcast
UpdateLive.description_zh: 更新指定直播相关信息

UpdateLiveRoom.description_en: Updates the information of a specified live room by calling UpdateLiveRoom
UpdateLiveRoom.description_zh: 调用UpdateLiveRoom更新指定直播相关信息

UpdateRoom.description_en: Calls UpdateRoom to update all modifiable information of a room
UpdateRoom.description_zh: 调用UpdateRoom更新房间所有可修改信息

UpdateShareScreenLayout.description_en: Updates the shared screen layout by calling UpdateShareScreenLayout. This operation can be used in classroom scenarios to overlay the teacher's camera feed on the shared screen in a live stream
UpdateShareScreenLayout.description_zh: 调用UpdateShareScreenLayout更新共享屏幕布局。可用于课堂场景，直播画面中共享屏幕画面叠加老师摄像头画面
